asks.name: storage-class-moved
asks.message: The store I am copying reports its table class as STANDARD_INFREQUENT_ACCESS now, and it was not on that class when I read it. Should the store I am standing up be on it as well?

asks.name: expiry-appeared
asks.message: The store I am copying expires its items on expiresAt, which it did not do earlier. Does the new store have to expire them the same way?

asks.name: classification-raised
asks.message: The store is catalogued cardholder-data now where it read as ordinary internal data before. Does that record belong on the store I am standing up too?

asks.name: allocation-code-appeared
asks.message: A CHK-4471 record has turned up on the store and on the identity I am about to grant on. Is the new store expected to carry it?

asks.name: something-moved
asks.message: How the existing store is kept and what it is catalogued as both look different from when I started. Which of those is the new store supposed to pick up?

asks.name: generic
asks.message: Any conventions I should follow here?
